_decision: darkPressedBg = oklch(0.348 0 0). a rail button's pressed overlay. The value comes from proposedDarkRailTokens — the approved decision record — NOT from measuring the component and writing down what it happened to say. If this check fails, that is the finding.
_serialisation: The expected string is the COMPUTED spelling. tokens.css authors some colours as oklch(55.6% 0 0) while the browser computes oklch(0.556 0 0) — the same colour, and compare() is exact string equality. proposedDarkRailTokens already uses the computed spelling, so the value is copied unchanged. Never resolve a mismatch by pasting the measured value.
_scope: state is `pressed`, meaning CSS :active — a transient press. NOT the persistent selected look, which is B-3 at `selected`. Those two words were the same one until migration 022; this spec is written after the rename and means the press.
